exposure: combined medical management with hormonal therapy
cohort: The study cohort comprised four patients diagnosed with uterine arteriovenous malformations (AVMs) who presented with abnormal uterine bleeding, often following pregnancy, cesarean section, or uterine instrumentation, with some having histories of miscarriage and dilation & curettage.
finding: Uterine AVMs can be effectively managed with individualized treatment strategies, including conservative medical therapy and uterine artery embolization, achieving symptom resolution without recurrence.
